2447.text: Instructing, advising, consoling, comforting are spiritual works of mercy, as are forgiving and bearing wrongs patiently. [...] feeding the hungry, sheltering the homeless, clothing the naked, visiting the sick and imprisoned, and burying the dead.
2447.notes: PARTIAL: only the quoted part was returned verbatim by the fetch. scborromeo.org mirror of the Vatican text; one vatican.va fetch makes it canonical. Does not number the works as fourteen or call them binding (entry 69).
